scripts.start: docker compose -f local-mail-server/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait && docker compose -f postgres/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env.development up -d --wait && docker compose -f auth-server/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env.development up -d --build --wait && echo Frontend: http://localhost:5173 && echo Keycloak: http://localhost:8080 && echo Mailpit: http://localhost:8025 && dotenv -e .env.development -- corepack pnpm --dir web dev
scripts.stop: docker compose -f auth-server/docker-compose.yml down && docker compose -f postgres/docker-compose.yml down && docker compose -f local-mail-server/docker-compose.yml down
scripts.start-gateway: docker compose -f local-mail-server/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait && docker compose -f api-gateway/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env.traefik up -d --wait && docker compose -f postgres/docker-compose.gateway.yml --env-file .env.traefik up -d --wait && docker compose -f auth-server/docker-compose.gateway.yml --env-file .env.traefik up -d --build --wait && docker compose -f web/docker-compose.gateway.yml --env-file .env.traefik up -d --build --wait && echo App: http://app.localhost && echo Keycloak: http://auth.localhost && echo Traefik: http://localhost:8081 && echo Mailpit: http://localhost:8025
scripts.stop-gateway: docker compose -f web/docker-compose.gateway.yml down && docker compose -f auth-server/docker-compose.gateway.yml down && docker compose -f postgres/docker-compose.gateway.yml down && docker compose -f api-gateway/docker-compose.yml down && docker compose -f local-mail-server/docker-compose.yml down
scripts.check: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm --dir web lint && dotenv -e .env.development -- corepack pnpm --dir web typecheck
